dev-runs/<set>/shard-<i>-of-<n>.jsonl.reason: per-world wall-clock milliseconds (run-dev.mjs diagnoseWorld: Math.round(performance.now() - t0)); present on admitted rows only

normalization.preserved: every other field and value, object key order, row order and row count
normalization.serialization:
JSONL: each line JSON.stringify(row without ms), joined by "
" with a trailing "
". done.json: JSON.stringify(record without seconds, null, 1) + "
"
normalization.precondition: every raw line equals JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(line)) and every done.json equals JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 1) + "\n"; otherwise NORMALIZATION_REFUSED
normalization.notNormalized: identity.frozenAgrees can become "ERROR:COMPUTE_LIMIT_OR_SOURCE_MISMATCH" if a frozen lock exceeds its 1,000 ms assertion; it is a scientific integrity field, is NOT removed, and any change is reported as a difference
normalization.hash: sha256 of the normalized UTF-8 bytes

runtime.note: recorded at manifest time; the original run used the same node on PATH (v22.22.2, binary 5c899797..., the V4 runtime), not separately recorded then

sourceIdentity.measuredBy: trace-hooks.mjs load hook + instrumented fs.readFileSync, exercising run-dev.mjs code paths

regenerationLayout: DEV288: 1 shard; FRESH_EXPLORE and FRESH_CHECK: 5 shards each (idx % 5); shards may run in parallel. The commands write with exclusive creation, so dev-runs/<set>/ must not already contain the shard.
